## About
All Around Automotive started with an old adage: treat people the way we would want to be treated. We still believe that is the right way to run a shop. Our focus is preventative maintenance and vehicle repair, with quality parts and a strong warranty behind the work.
We have been part of this SE Portland neighborhood for a long time and support local organizations. Our customer service team will take the time to explain any recommendations and answer your questions, and our technicians keep their training and equipment current as cars change.
We also try to do right by the environment. We recycle oil, filters, antifreeze, metals, batteries and more, and we keep looking for new green ideas. Customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 113 Google reviews.

## Services
- Drivability and engine diagnostics: Tracking down running problems, plus computer system analysis, repair and reprogramming.
- DEQ certified repairs: State certified DEQ repairs, with dynamometers for accurate NoX testing.
- Thousand mile maintenance services: Maintenance services at 30, 60, 90, 120 and 150 thousand miles.
- Pre-purchase inspections: Have a used car checked over before you buy it.
- Air conditioning repair and conversions: Repairs and conversions for your air conditioning.
- RV service: We work on motorhomes as well as cars, light trucks and vans.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open 8 to 5, Monday through Friday, and closed on weekends.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We are on SE Division St in Portland.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Most makes and models of cars, light trucks, vans and motorhomes, whether gas, diesel or hybrid.

Q: Can you help with towing or a rental car?
A: Yes. We can arrange towing and a rental car on request.
